subject: Core Mathematics
title: Area of Polygons
verified_by: Codex visual inspection of original local PDF rendering, 2026-11-12

outcomes.text: derive the formula for the area of a triangle given two sides and an included angle,
work out the area of a triangle given two sides and an included angle,
determine the area of a triangle using Heron’s formula,
determine the area of quadrilaterals in different situations,
work out the area of regular heptagon and octagon,
determine the area of irregular polygons in different situations,
explore the area of polygons as used in real-life situations.

inquiry_questions: How do we work out the area of polygons?
How do we apply the concept of the area of polygons in real-life situations?

coreCompetencies:
Critical Thinking and Problem Solving: the learner uses trigonometric ratios to generate the formula for a triangle given two sides and an included angle.
Creativity and Imagination: the learner identifies from the immediate environment objects in the shape of regular polygons and calculates their area.
Learning to Learn: the learners research and discuss the use of the area of polygons in real-life situations.
values:
Patriotism: the learner uses the objects from the environment and takes care of the environment.
Responsibility: the learner identifies objects from the immediate environment to use in calculating the area of regular polygons.
Peace: the learner harmoniously discusses in groups and uses trigonometric ratios to generate the formula for the area of a triangle given two sides and an included angle.
pcis: Environmental Education: the learner collects objects from the immediate environment to be used as learning materials for area of polygons.
